event.notes: "name" is matched as a substring against ESPN's own event name (punctuation and case are ignored, but spelling is NOT — no typo tolerance here, unlike fighter-name matching elsewhere), and the FIRST match inside the 45-day scoreboard window wins. That last part is why a weekly series must carry its season and week: ESPN names this card "Dana White's Contender Series: Season 10, Week 3", and "Contender Series" alone would match whichever week sits earliest in the window rather than this one. A one-off card ("UFC 330", "Hernandez vs. Rodrigues") is unique in that window and needs no qualifier. If the run logs "No ESPN card found matching ...", the name is wrong: nothing is filtered that run and off-card fights come back.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Humphrey is a pressure striker with solid wrestling against an awkward, unimpressive Miranda; called a lock and one of his most confident picks.

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: Humphrey's nasty Muay Thai, poise and 100% finish rate versus a completely unremarkable Miranda who has no power and has been outstruck by low-level opposition; expects the knockout within two rounds. Notes -950 moneyline isn't parlayable.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Miranda is hittable, doesn't move his head, leaves his chin up and has poor takedown defense; Humphrey beats him everywhere and should land big shots early.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Humphrey is 4-0 with all KOs and throws with huge power, while Miranda gets backed up, has no finishing ability or jiu-jitsu to threaten him.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Calls it a night-and-day athletic gap: Humphrey is far more explosive, powerful and faster, and should either chin Miranda on the feet or ground-and-pound him out early.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Says Humphrey walks him down, lands something big and finishes early; suggests propping him by TKO.

options.selection: Ronald Humphrey by KO/TKO in round 1

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Humphrey throws with big power, strikes and wrestles well, while Miranda has shown no power, poor takedown defense and fights on the back foot, so Humphrey has nothing to respect and should land something big early.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Mir is elite grappler - national champion wrestler, IBJJF no-gi and Pan-American champion - with improving striking, and he thinks she was given a favorable matchup.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Mir should be one of the biggest favorites of the season - national champion wrestler with UFC BJJ grappling experience - facing an opponent on three weeks' notice whose striking he doesn't rate.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Mir's grappling and jiu-jitsu are far superior and Apodaca's takedown defense won't hold up; listed as a most confident pick.

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: Mir is clearly the better wrestler and grappler with more explosiveness and power, though he notes -4000 isn't parlayable and there's little to bet.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: National champion wrestler who dominates once on top and finds submissions; Apodaca walks into the clinch and can't hurt her on the feet.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Very confident in her wrestling to get it to the floor and finish with a first-round submission.

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: He expects Mir to take the fight down, get whatever position she wants and eventually find a submission; interested in the submission prop if the price is bettable.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Apodaca runs into the pocket with hands down and chin up, which lets Mir duck under to the hips; Mir is very good once she gets the takedown, having taken a Kimura off her last opponent.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He expects her to get the takedown and find an early submission; recommends the Mir-by-sub prop.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: Petrazella is an explosive, wild combination striker while Galante's striking is hittable, and Petrazella's jiu-jitsu should stop or survive Galante's takedown attempts. Named as his 'savage underdog lock'.

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: He picks Galante to win because his wrestling should be the difference maker and he can find safety in takedowns, but he thinks the -250 price is too wide and that Petrazzella's BJJ and aggression make it tougher than the odds suggest.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Galante needs takedowns to win and Petrazella has decent takedown defense and sprawls well; if the takedowns are stopped, Galante is hittable and gets caught with big shots.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He believes Petrazella lands one big shot and gets a highlight-reel knockout on Galante.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Galante needs takedowns to win but Petrozzella sprawls well and has decent takedown defense; Galante is hittable and can get caught with big shots. Also framed as a fade on Galante.

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Grappler vs grappler fight where Galante consistently takes the back in his fights and should out-scramble Petraella; if not a sub, a control-based decision.

cappers.name: Axel MMA
cappers.reasoning: He expects it to end early with Galante getting caught cold in the first round.

fights.display: Gary Balletto vs Sean Clancy Jr.

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: Clancy is one of the best prospects of the season, has stepped up in competition, and his cage pressure plus excellent body work should overwhelm Balletto, who hasn't fought MMA in over a year and has been out-sped and out-scrambled before.

options.selection: Sean Clancy Jr. by TKO (body shot), likely round 2

cappers.name: We Want Picks (Jacob)
cappers.reasoning: Clancy's boxing and body work have evolved and Balletto leaves himself open to counters in MMA; a submission is also possible but he lands on the KO.

cappers.name: Livid Larry MMA
cappers.reasoning: Clancy is the better prospect and more talented everywhere; since Balletto is durable and hard to finish to the head, he expects Clancy to soften him up with kicks to the body and finish with a body-shot TKO in the second.

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: Clancy Jr. is a far superior, much bigger well-rounded grappler who should get Balletto down almost immediately and finish quickly; he'd take the under 1.5 at anything better than -300.

options.selection: Sean Clancy Jr. by KO/TKO in round 1

cappers.name: Artem MMA
cappers.reasoning: He expects the pressure and body work to add up quickly against a fighter coming off a long MMA layoff, predicting a first-round knockout.

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: Calls Piazon the best dog on the card, fading Uriel's poor gas tank and rudimentary overextending power striking, while Piazon has shown he can go into rounds two and three and grapple.

cappers.name: The Wager Zone
cappers.reasoning: Close fight, but Pinzon is hittable and swings wild hooks; Uriel can straighten up a shot, mix in wrestling and has faced better competition.

options.selection: Mario Piazzon by TKO in round 2 or 3

cappers.name: MMA Lock of the Night
cappers.reasoning: Expects Piazon to create a slugfest, wear Uriel down in the clinch and finish him by TKO once Uriel gasses in the later rounds.
